home.title: 瓷时
home.motto: Your birthday has a story in porcelain.
home.intro: Enter your birthday and meet one Chinese ceramic work from the long river of history.

conn.exact: This day truly exists in ceramic history: {{event}} It is not the creation date of this piece — {{name}} belongs to {{period}} — but the day itself is porcelain's, and we kept it for you.
conn.near: Within {{days}} day(s) of your birthday, this happened in ceramics: {{event}} We brought you the work nearest that moment — not its creation date, but a closeness in time.
conn.thematic: No exact creation date survives for {{name}}, and we will not invent one. Your birthday falls in {{season}}; following {{motif}}, we chose a piece from {{period}} for this day.

note: Image: {{credit}}. Periods are approximate; no exact creation date is claimed.
